title: Intent contract cannot drift: documented fields == code, an example intent that loads, unknown keys refused
objective: Bind the documented badf init intent contract to the code: a drift test compares README's table to INTENT_REQUIRED / INTENT_OPTIONAL / INTENT_TARGETS; examples/intent.json loads; load_intent refuses unknown keys so a typo cannot silently become DECLARED_MISSING.
business_value: The README section (WP-0021) can fall behind the code silently; a mistyped optional key today is ignored and the value invented as DECLARED_MISSING.
in_scope: INTENT_OPTIONAL constant; load_intent refuses unknown keys
tests/test_badf_intent_docs.py (README table vs code; example loads; unknown key refused; the gate reads exactly INTENT_OPTIONAL)
out_of_scope: any change to the intent fields themselves
acceptance_criteria: README rows == INTENT_REQUIRED (yes) and INTENT_OPTIONAL (no); target row names every INTENT_TARGETS value
examples/intent.json passes load_intent and uses exactly the documented keys
an intent with an unknown key is refused naming the key
mutation: removing the unknown-key check or drifting a README row is caught

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design. Carries the withdrawal of WP-2026-0026 / rejection of BADF-DEM-0013 (#24, false premise).
